part: RS485 energy meter (class 1), Modbus RTU slave
interface: RS485 Modbus RTU, SIM is bus master; register map served as MCP resource
failure_modes: Modbus timeout: sensor_ok bit drops; a comms fault is not a zero-power reading
register value frozen across load changes: stuck slave, power-cycle the meter
energy counter going backwards: register decode error, check word order against the map
mounting: panel-mounted; meter powered from AC inlet; load on metered outlet
